captions: Her river. Every Sunday, she walked you here.
Her coat pocket always had dates in it. For you.
She made du'a for you out loud. You used to roll your eyes.
Then the funeral. Then work. Then two years.
Today an old man in a boat lifts his hand to you. Like she did.
Twenty years she prayed for you. You stopped at two.
You take the long way. Third row, under the olive tree.
You raise your hands. Your voice shakes on her name.
“Ya Allah, forgive her. Fill her grave with light.”
She asked Him for you for twenty years. Now it's your turn.

post.caption:
730 days since Grandma left. You asked Allah for her twice. 🌙

She walked you along her river every Sunday, dates in her coat pocket, making du'a for you out loud. Twenty years she prayed for you. You stopped at two.

“Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.” (2:186)

Before Maghrib today: one du'a for her. Say her name.
